tools.description: Read one organization profile with public metadata, aggregate activity, and a bounded package portfolio.

tools.description: Find dedicated s&box servers by name, game, or map with current occupancy and source URLs.

tools.name: get_activity_history
tools.description: Read bounded player history for all public games, all dedicated servers, or one game.
